concerns.text: T000c (Verify Sample Size) is placed in Phase 0 (Research) but depends on the merged dataset produced by T013 (Merge Datasets) in Phase 3. A task cannot verify sample size adequacy against a dataset that has not yet been ingested or merged. T000c must be moved to Phase 3 or 4, after T013.

T039 (Regression Diagnostic Suite) is tagged [P] (parallel-safe) and placed in Phase 2 (Foundational). However, it depends on regression models being fitted (T021) and residuals being available. It cannot run before the analysis phase. Additionally, it is not parallel-safe as it requires the output of the sequential regression loop. Move to Phase 4 and remove [P] tag.

T020a (Generate Synthetic Merged Dataset) is placed in Phase 4 (US2) but is a prerequisite for T020 (Compute Pearson Correlations) and T038 (Run Analysis on Synthetic Dataset) which are also in Phase 4. While they are in the same phase, T020a must strictly precede T020 and T038 to ensure the test data exists before the analysis logic is invoked. Reorder within Phase 4.

T055 (Hash user_id) is placed in Phase 3 (US1) after T015 (Prepare Unified Data). However, T055 produces the `unified_data.csv` with hashed IDs. If T015 outputs a file with raw IDs, and T055 is a separate task, the downstream tasks (T016, T017) might be reading the wrong version or the pipeline is ambiguous. T055 should be integrated into T015 or immediately precede it to ensure the 'Unified Data' artifact is consistently hashed before any further processing or validation.

T065 (Update contracts to reflect hashed user_id) is placed in Phase N (Polish). However, T055 (Hashing) and T036 (Schema Validation) in Phase 3 depend on the schema defining `user_id` as a 64-char hex string. If the contract is updated in Phase N, T036 will fail validation against the old schema during Phase 3. T065 must be moved to Phase 2 (Foundational) before any schema validation tasks run.

T018 (Verify Checksums) is in Phase 2 (Foundational) but depends on files in `data/raw/` being populated. T012a and T012b (Populate `data/raw/`) are in Phase 3. T018 cannot run before the raw data is downloaded. Move T018 to Phase 3, after T012b.

T038 (Update Project State) is in Phase 2 (Foundational) but depends on artifacts from Phase 3 (Data Ingestion) and Phase 4 (Analysis) to update hashes. It is listed as a generic task but placed too early. It should be a recurring task or moved to the end of each phase, not a single task in Phase 2.

T070 (CI Benchmark for Ingestion Runtime) is in Phase N but depends on the ingestion tasks (T012a, T012b, etc.) being implemented. While tests can be written in parallel, the task description implies running the benchmark on the CI runner. If the ingestion tasks are not yet merged, this test will fail. Ensure T070 is logically dependent on the completion of Phase 3 tasks, or clarify it is a test file creation task only.
